1. (Currently amended) A system for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: a processor; and a memory, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, wherein the top-level lexical cloud comprises a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on frequency of occurrence, and wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: __creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a selected keyword from the data structure__; and __generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure as a second subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the second subset is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to __receive a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud and__ display a lexical cloud and obtain a selection of a keyword in the lexical cloud.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, on __sequential selections of keywords from the top-level lexical cloud and one or more lower-level lexical clouds__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, comprising a storage device that comprises __one or more of: technical documents, patents, Web pages, word processing documents, spreadsheet documents, or any combinations thereof__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 4, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to access files stored __in__ the storage device and to generate the plurality of keywords from the files __by extracting words from the files, excluding common words, and stemming the remaining words__.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the top-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and the frequency distribution of keywords in the data structure__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to __direct the processor to__ determine a number of keywords in the lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and the frequency distribution of keywords in the temporary data structure__.

8. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a size of each keyword in a lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on the frequency of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

9. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to select a subset of the plurality of keywords based, at least in part, on a frequency of occurrence of each keyword in the data structure.

10. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate the top-level lexical cloud, a plurality of lower level lexical clouds, or both in real time.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate a list of items to display based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and the items associated with keywords selected from the top-level lexical cloud and lower-level lexical clouds__.

12. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on __aesthetic descriptions, physical characteristics, or measurements obtained from a sensor during examination of the items__.

13. (Currently amended) A method for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: generating a data structure in a non-transitory, computer readable medium, comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generating a top-level lexical cloud, wherein the top-level lexical cloud comprises a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on frequency of occurrence, and wherein each keyword in the subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure; and generating a plurality of lower-level lexical clouds, wherein each lower-level lexical cloud is generated by: __creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a particular one of the plurality of keywords from the data structure__; and generating the lower level lexical cloud as a second subset of the plurality of keywords that remain in the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second subset is chosen by the overall frequency of occurrence in the temporary data structure __after creation of the temporary data structure by removal of any items not associated with a particular one of the plurality of keywords__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising obtaining the plurality of keywords by: obtaining a list of words associated with an item; excluding common words from the list; stemming words to obtain the plurality of keywords; and storing each of the plurality of keywords in the data structure __in association with frequency data for each keyword across the plurality of items__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising __receiving a user selection of a first keyword from the top level lexical cloud, generating a corresponding lower-level lexical cloud, receiving a user selection of a second keyword from the lower level lexical cloud, and__ displaying a list of items selected from the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a selection of a first keyword from the top level lexical cloud and a selection of a second keyword from the lower level lexical cloud.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising generating at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on __aesthetic descriptions, physical characteristics, or other information__ provided during physical examination of the items.

18. (Currently amended) A non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising code configured to direct a processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: __creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a selected keyword from the data structure__; and __generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure as a second subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the second subset is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure__.

19. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to __receive a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud and__ display a lexical cloud and obtain a selection of a keyword from the lexical cloud.

20. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon __sequential selections of a first keyword from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword from the lower-level lexical cloud__.
